claim: The actual image, built from the committed tree with podman, passes the CI image job's checks and more: labelled with and reporting its release, refuses to serve without a database or with the owner credential, provisions its own database, not ready until data is published and ready after, serves the UI, 401 when unauthenticated, not root, an Exec and a RAM sign in on a freshly provisioned database and get the right answers over real sessions, sign-out ends the session, clean stop on SIGTERM; and a trivy scan of the exact image finds no HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerability with a fix available.
